prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: 6 hour flight and my leg is crammed into the back of the seat. Only 6'1 and have no leg rm.  why do your seats keep getting smaller?
Delta: ...seats hasn't changed. *ABN 2/2

Customer: Stuck on tarmack in BCN for 1.5 hours and need help with our connecting flight after this. Please help! #Delta #MechanicalProblem #Delayed
Delta: Good morning. Please DM your confirmation number that I may check options for you. Thanks. *TAS https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: Shoutout to  for the stellar customer service. Usually companies just get dogged in SM but they need to be commended too. 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽 https://t.co/wD9bqAqNmh
Delta: Thank you! We truly appreciate you and your feedback. *TMB

Customer: check your DMs please thanks
Delta: Hi, Joshua. My apologies for any confusion. Allow me a few minutes to review your reservation. *HJH

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: loyalty_refund_compensation):
"""think my SM# may have been accidentally removed from one leg of my Jet Airways flight - can u help check?"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Hi there! Please DM us your SkyMiles number and the flight details so we can look into it for you. Thank you.
